message_pattern: all attempts to scrape url had failed
dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && ($l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' || $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker') && $d.message == 'all attempts to scrape url had failed' | extract $d.error.message:string into $d.ej using jsonobject() | extract $d.context.url:string into $d.u using regexp(e=/https?:\/\/(?<host>[^\/:?#]+)/) | groupby $l.subsystemname, $d.u.host:string as host, $d.ej.type:string as etype aggregate count() as n | orderby n desc
volume: 2026-11-02 24h: crawl 5,488, scan 59. Types: OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT 5,502; FAILED_TO_RUN_ENGINES 20; DNS_ERROR_COULD_NOT_FIND_URL 13; INTERNAL_ERROR 10; PAGE_INTERACTION_PLUGIN_ERROR 4
noise: This is the one record per URL that really failed (not a retry). Volume is dominated by a few hosts (www.aa.com 82% of OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT). Signal = failure share for the ticket's property/host.
notes: Route by .type: OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT -> D1 if few URLs on a healthy host, A1/A2 if most of the host fails; FAILED_TO_RUN_ENGINES -> D2; DNS_ERROR_COULD_NOT_FIND_URL -> C4 (bad host); PAGE_INTERACTION_PLUGIN_ERROR -> B2/B4; INTERNAL_ERROR -> product bug.

message_pattern: all attempts to scrape url had failed + $d.error.message {"type":"OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT"}
dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && ($l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' || $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker') && $d.message == 'all attempts to scrape url had failed' && $d.error.message:string ~ 'OPEN_PAGE_TIMEOUT' | extract $d.context.url:string into $d.u using regexp(e=/https?:\/\/(?<host>[^\/:?#]+)/) | groupby $d.u.host:string as host aggregate count() as n
noise: Chronic background on a few big sites. Signal when the ticket's host is >~20% of its URLs, or new compared with earlier runs.
notes: Disambiguate with http status lines (403/429 -> A1/A5), host-wide vs few URLs (A vs D1), and the page title/'Just a moment'.

message_pattern: encountered error while running a function with timeout. retry count: N + $d.error.message errorDescription 'Error. Function: gotoURL execution took more than (60000|40000) miliseconds'
dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && ($l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' || $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker') && $d.message ~ 'encountered error while running a function with timeout' | extract $d.error.message:string into $d.ej using jsonobject() | groupby $l.subsystemname, $d.ej.errorDescription:string as d aggregate count() as n, approx_count_distinct($d.context.request_id) as urls
volume: 2026-11-02 24h: crawl gotoURL>60000 17,263 attempts / 6,126 URLs; scan gotoURL>40000 157 / 104 URLs
noise: Per-ATTEMPT record (~2.8 per URL). Do not count it as failures; a URL that recovers on retry emits this but no all-attempts record. Use all-attempts for failures.
notes: Zendesk 'gotoURL ... 40000' is the scan-worker limit; crawl uses 60000.

message_pattern: encountered error while running a function with timeout + errorDescription 'Function: bound run execution took more than (20000|30000|60000|90000|120000) miliseconds'
dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker' && $d.message ~ 'encountered error while running a function with timeout' && $d.error.message:string ~ 'bound run execution' | extract $d.error.message:string into $d.ej using jsonobject() | groupby $d.ej.errorDescription:string aggregate count() as n
noise: Rare; each one is a real page whose engine/plugin step hung
notes: Timeout value names the plugin step (20 s and 30 s are probably interaction/stabilise, 90/120 s the engines). Pair with 'got error while running plugin'.

message_pattern: errorDescription 'Function: bound handleRequest execution took more than 300000 miliseconds'
dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && ($l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker' || $l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker') && $d.error.message:string ~ 'bound handleRequest execution took more than'
notes: 5-minute whole-page cap; on a login URL it points to a multi-step login (B4).

dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && ($l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' || $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker') && $d.message ~ 'http status code is: ' | extract $d.message:string into $d.x using regexp(e=/status code is: (?<code>[0-9]+)/) | extract $d.context.url:string into $d.u using regexp(e=/https?:\/\/(?<host>[^\/:?#]+)/) | groupby $d.u.host:string as host, $d.x.code:string as code aggregate count() as n | orderby n desc
noise: Info level, the page is NOT failed: the error/block page is scanned. Scattered 404s are normal; the signal is a high non-200 ratio for one host.
notes: 403/405 -> A1; 429 -> A5; 404 on seeds -> C4; 401 -> B5; 5xx on customer host -> customer outage (C4-ish). Filter with != '200' on the extracted code (character classes inside ~ did not match).

dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && ($l.subsystemname == 'crawl-worker' || $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker') && $d.message ~ 'Failed to load resource: net::ERR_' | extract $d.message:string into $d.x using regexp(e=/(?<code>net::ERR_[A-Z0-9_]+)/) | groupby $l.subsystemname, $d.x.code:string aggregate count() as n
noise: BENIGN background: page sub-resources (trackers, blocked third parties). Ignore unless ERR_HTTP2_SERVER_REFUSED_STREAM / ERR_CERT_* or nearly every request for one host fails.
notes: ERR_HTTP2_SERVER_REFUSED_STREAM -> A5; not seen in this window.

message_pattern: encountered error while running a function with timeout + $d.error.message {"url":"<page url>","message":"No element found for selector: <sel>"}
dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && ($m.templateid == '9b5233c6-9b48-11f1-bb8a-4206745c74cb' || $m.templateid == '3f414be4-9c6f-11f1-a76b-3e8752cb6a06' || $m.templateid == '23a24bcc-b0f1-11f1-8b5b-aedcf7151837') && $d.error.message:string ~ 'No element found for selector' | extract $d.error.message:string into $d.ej using jsonobject() | groupby $l.subsystemname, $d.ej.message:string as msg, $d.ej.url:string as final_url aggregate count() as n, approx_count_distinct($d.context.url) as urls | orderby n desc
noise: Always signal for the property. The final-type rollup is PAGE_INTERACTION_PLUGIN_ERROR (509 on 10-28).
notes: url=about:blank or same page -> B2 selector mismatch; url=/login|/guest|SSO host mid-crawl -> B5 session lost or B4 flow; url=out-of-country page -> A7.

dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && ($m.templateid == '9b5233c6-9b48-11f1-bb8a-4206745c74cb' || $m.templateid == '3f414be4-9c6f-11f1-a76b-3e8752cb6a06' || $m.templateid == '23a24bcc-b0f1-11f1-8b5b-aedcf7151837') && $d.error.message:string ~ '"url":' | extract $d.error.message:string into $d.ej using jsonobject() | filter $d.ej.url:string ~ 'login' || $d.ej.url:string ~ 'guest' || $d.ej.url:string ~ 'authenti' || $d.ej.url:string ~ 'out-of-country' | groupby $d.ej.url:string aggregate count() as n, any_value($d.context.url) as page
notes: Mid-crawl redirect to login/guest = session lost (B5) or bad credentials (B3); out-of-country = geo block A7.

dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker' && $d.error.message:string ~ 'FAILED_TO_RUN_ENGINES' | extract $d.error.message:string into $d.ej using jsonobject() | extract $d.context.url:string into $d.u using regexp(e=/https?:\/\/(?<host>[^\/:?#]+)/) | groupby $d.u.host:string as host, substr($d.ej.additionalInfo.stackTrace:string,0,80) as st aggregate count() as n
notes: The stackTrace tells which engine/DOM property broke ('checked', 'value').

message_pattern: {"type":"ENGINES_PLUGIN_ERROR","additionalInfo":{"details":"Error: ENOENT|ENOTEMPTY ... | ZlibError | SyntaxError: Unexpected end of input"}}
dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker' && $d.error.message:string ~ 'ENGINES_PLUGIN_ERROR' | extract $d.error.message:string into $d.ej using jsonobject() | groupby substr($d.ej.additionalInfo.details:string,0,60) as d aggregate count() as n, any_value($d.context.url) as url
noise: Not caused by the customer page: engine bundle download/extract race on the worker filesystem.
notes: Candidate new sub-issue: 'engine package load failure on worker' (Evinced-side). Looks like D2 to the customer (pages missing).

message_pattern: final .type in PLUGIN_TIMEOUT | INTERNAL_ERROR | DNS_ERROR_COULD_NOT_FIND_URL | SCREENSHOT_PLUGIN_ERROR | LINK_EXTRACTION_PLUGIN_ERROR
dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && ($m.templateid == '9b5222f0-9b48-11f1-bb8a-4206745c74cb' || $m.templateid == '0d569b2a-9b5c-11f1-a137-c2fc7991ad86') | extract $d.error.message:string into $d.ej using jsonobject() | groupby formatTimestamp($m.timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d') as day, $d.ej.type:string as etype aggregate count() as n
volume: 7d: PLUGIN_TIMEOUT 420 (tsn.ca, noovo.info), INTERNAL_ERROR 180, DNS_ERROR 44 final (132 per-attempt; capitalone, smartpaylease int host)
notes: DNS_ERROR -> C4 (host does not resolve publicly, e.g. internal QA hosts -> needs a private agent / wrong seed). INTERNAL_ERROR (Scraper.ts:139) -> product bug. PLUGIN_TIMEOUT -> D1.

message_pattern: got error while scraping net::ERR_(CONNECTION_REFUSED|CONNECTION_RESET|TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS|HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR) at <url>  (also as plain text in $d.error.message)
dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && ($m.templateid == '9b5233c6-9b48-11f1-bb8a-4206745c74cb' || $m.templateid == '3f414be4-9c6f-11f1-a76b-3e8752cb6a06' || $m.templateid == '23a24bcc-b0f1-11f1-8b5b-aedcf7151837') && $d.error.message:string ~ 'net::ERR_' | extract $d.error.message:string into $d.x using regexp(e=/(?<code>net::ERR_[A-Z0-9_]+) at https?:\/\/(?<host>[^\/:?#]+)/) | groupby $d.x.code:string, $d.x.host:string aggregate count() as n
volume: 7d: ERR_CONNECTION_RESET telebec.com ~390; ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS moo.com/denverbariatrics ~40; ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR discover.com 18; ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED HCA hospital sites ~8/day
noise: Signal (it is the page itself, unlike the [browser] lines)
notes: RESET/HTTP2_PROTOCOL host-wide -> A1 WAF; TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS -> A8; CONNECTION_REFUSED -> host down / C4. No ERR_CERT_* seen (A9).

message_pattern: Execution context was destroyed, most likely because of a navigation | Navigating frame was detached | Attempted to use detached Frame
dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && ($m.templateid == '9b5233c6-9b48-11f1-bb8a-4206745c74cb' || $m.templateid == '3f414be4-9c6f-11f1-a76b-3e8752cb6a06' || $m.templateid == '23a24bcc-b0f1-11f1-8b5b-aedcf7151837') && ($d.error.message:string ~ 'Execution context was destroyed' || $d.error.message:string ~ 'detached') | groupby $d.context.url aggregate count() as n
noise: Signal for that page, low volume
notes: The page navigates or reloads itself (redirect script, consent reload, bot challenge reload).

message_pattern: scan page <url> failed, scan id is <scanId>. last successful result file prod-mon/tasks/<scanId>/results/joiner-results/<id>.json
dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $l.subsystemname == 'scrape-server' && $d.message ~ ' failed, scan id is ' | extract $d.message:string into $d.x using regexp(e=/scan page (?<url>[^ ]+) failed, scan id is (?<sid>[0-9a-f-]+)/) | groupby $d.x.sid:string aggregate count() as pages, any_value($d.x.url) as sample
key_fields: url and scanId in the message
noise: Roll-up with no reason; documents (pdf/zip) are expected. Use it to list a scan's dropped pages, then join to scan-worker by URL for the reason.
notes: The scanId in the message lets the investigator go from a ticket's scanId to the failed pages.

message_pattern: content type: <ct> doesn't match the: text/html,text/plain
dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && ($m.templateid == 'a92c1eca-a74c-11f1-9144-fab0241da207' || $m.templateid == 'e7b5fc88-aaf8-11f1-b655-422d8edb1526') | extract $d.message:string into $d.x using regexp(e=/content type: (?<ct>[^ ]+) /) | groupby $d.x.ct:string aggregate count() as n
noise: BENIGN: non-HTML links are skipped by design
notes: Relevant only if a customer asks why PDFs aren't scanned, or the seed itself is a document.

message_pattern: got error while trying to upload file to cloud. retry count: N, local path: ..., bucket: prod-mon-production, bucket path: prod-mon/tasks/<scanId>/results/crawl.json | error uploading file to bucket
dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $l.subsystemname == 'scan-worker' && ($d.message ~ 'upload file to cloud' || $d.message ~ 'error uploading file to bucket') | extract $d.message:string into $d.x using regexp(e=/tasks\/(?<sid>[0-9a-f-]+)\//) | groupby $d.x.sid:string, substr($d.error.message:string,0,60) as e aggregate count() as n
noise: Evinced-side; usually harmless if a later write succeeds. Signal if the same scan ends FAILED/incomplete.
notes: GCS per-object mutation rate limit: crawl.json rewritten too often on big scans.

message_pattern: not handling request after reading it from the queue. reason: matching grouping <regex> is full | max number of successful visits was reached
dataprime: source logs | filter $l.applicationname == 'site-scanner' && $m.templateid == '08e4a5d0-9b45-11f1-a536-52ef7929d954' | groupby $d.context.url aggregate count() as n
noise: BENIGN: the configured page/grouping cap working as intended
notes: Relevant only for 'why did the crawl stop at N pages' (grouping limits, C5).
